split_strategy: Manual. The hardest cases (P4 indirect intent, N6 consumer-legal near-miss, N9 code task with keyword overlap) are in the train set so iteration has signal. Validation holds out cleaner generalization checks across positive industries (management_consulting, IT, marketing, BYO-list) and negative shapes (ecommerce, freelancer, industry research, generic finance).
passing_rule: should_trigger=true → trigger_rate > 0.5 over 3 runs. should_trigger=false → trigger_rate ≤ 0.5.
